parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The time range refers to the period of time during which the task is created. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the resources associated with the task. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. The time range refers to the period of time during which the task is created. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: TaskAction
parameters.description:
The name of the operation that generates the task. Valid values:

*   ImportImage
*   ExportImage
*   RedeployInstance
*   ModifyDiskSpec
*   ArchiveSnapshot

parameters.name: TaskIds
parameters.description: The task IDs. You can specify up to 100 task IDs at a time. Separate the task IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: TaskStatus
parameters.description:
The task status. Valid values:

*   Finished
*   Processing
*   Failed

This parameter is left empty by default.

>  The system only queries tasks in the Finished, Processing, and Failed states and ignores other values.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-tasks --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-ids t-bp1hvgwromzv32iq0000,t-bp179lofu2pv768w0000 --task-action ImportImage --task-status Finished --start-time 2020-11-23T15:10:00Z --end-time 2020-11-23T15:16:00Z --resource-ids m-bp1i8huqm5u70000 --task-group-id g-2ze2op2grqpclwu70000 --region cn-hangzhou
